Peanuts roasted with maple syrup, chilli, smoked paprika and sea salt until glassy and crunchy, served warm in a tin bucket on the bar. Heat the oven to 170C. Toss 400g raw peanuts with 3 tbsp maple syrup, 1 tbsp oil, 1 tsp chilli flakes, 1 tsp smoked paprika and 1 tsp salt. Spread on a lined tray and roast 15 to 18 minutes, stirring twice, until deep golden. Sprinkle with flaky salt and cool 10 minutes so the glaze hardens. Break up and serve in a bucket.

Dry-brined chicken with lemon and thyme butter under the skin, roasted golden, with crunchy roast potatoes, garlicky green beans and pan gravy. Salt a 1.8kg chicken and leave uncovered in the fridge overnight. Push 50g butter mashed with lemon zest and thyme under the breast skin. Roast at 220C for 20 minutes, then 180C for 50 minutes, with 1kg halved potatoes in oil around it. Rest 10 minutes. Make gravy from the juices with 1 tbsp flour and 300ml stock. Blanch 300g green beans and toss with butter and 1 sliced garlic clove.

Canadian rye whisky stirred with maple syrup and bitters over one big ice cube, finished with a flamed orange twist. In a jug with ice, stir 240ml Canadian rye whisky, 4 tsp maple syrup and 8 dashes aromatic bitters for 30 seconds until very cold. Strain into 4 heavy tumblers over one large ice cube each. Squeeze a strip of orange peel over each glass, rub the rim and drop it in.

s.note: Chewy oat and puffed rice bars bound with honey and peanut butter
s.how: Melt 60g butter, 80g honey and 100g peanut butter together. Stir through 150g rolled oats and 80g puffed rice cereal until coated. Press firmly into a lined tin, chill for 2 hours and cut into bars.

s.note: Red and green grapes rolled in lime juice and sugar, frozen solid
s.how: Pick 250g red and 250g green grapes off the stem, wash and dry. Roll in the juice of a lime, then in 50g caster sugar. Spread on a tray and freeze for at least 3 hours until solid. Serve straight from the freezer.

m.note: Chips topped with cheese curds and hot beef gravy
m.how: Fry 1kg potatoes cut into chips, at 140C then 185C. Cook 40g butter with 3 tbsp flour for 2 minutes, then whisk in 500ml beef stock and simmer until thick. Pile chips into bowls, scatter 250g cheese curds and pour the hot gravy over.

w.note: Very hard vanilla ice cream with hot dark chocolate poured on to set
w.how: Put four bowls in the freezer for an hour. Scoop 1L very hard vanilla ice cream into them. Melt 150g dark chocolate with 2 tbsp coconut oil and pour over at the table, so it sets into a shell in seconds.
